name: Asoko no Ten'in wa Kyou mo Shigoto Shinai
original_name: あそこの店員は今日も仕事しない
source:
Suddenly one day a man I knew called me.
"Want to come work at the shop?"
I figured it was just an ordinary job, so I went.
It was a themed concept cafe!
Self-styled supernatural, sorcerer or vampire.
My new life surrounded by personalized staff members begins!

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE089791.html]DLsite[/url]]
